name: Taco Salad
description: A hearty taco salad with seasoned ground beef, mixed greens, and crunchy corn chips.
recipeIngredient: ½ to ¾ small bottle Catalina dressing

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground hamburger in a frying pan with chopped mushrooms.
Add taco seasoning mix and a little water. Continue cooking until the mixture thickens.
In a large bowl, combine the premixed salad, sliced green pepper, and red onion.
When ready to serve, add the hamburger mixture, crushed corn chips, and Catalina dressing to the salad.
Toss everything together and serve immediately.

keywords: taco salad, Mexican salad, ground beef salad

_similar.name: Mexican Salad
_similar.description: A hearty and flavorful salad with kidney beans, lentils, and low-fat cheese, topped with salsa and served with taco chips.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup low-fat cheese (mozzarella or cheddar or combination)

recipeInstructions.text: Combine kidney beans, lentils, diced tomato, shredded lettuce, chopped green pepper, low-fat cheese, and green onions in a large bowl.
Toss the salad with Catalina dressing until well coated.
Top the salad with salsa.
Serve immediately with taco chips on the side.

_similar.keywords: Mexican salad, bean salad, taco chips

_similar.name: Pasta Salad
_similar.description: A colorful pasta salad with penne or spiral pasta, vegetables, feta cheese, and a tangy herb dressing.
recipeIngredient: ½ bag penne or spiral pasta

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the pasta according to package instructions, then drain and cool.
Add chopped green pepper, tomatoes, green onions, and sliced black olives to the cooled pasta.
Crumble the feta cheese into the pasta mixture.
Pour the Classic Herb dressing over the salad and toss to combine.

_similar.keywords: pasta salad, feta cheese, herb dressing, vegetable salad

_similar.name: Caribbean Chicken Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring chicken, mango, pineapple, and Minute Rice, all tossed in Italian dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 small can pineapple, diced and drained

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the Minute Rice in chicken broth according to package instructions.
Cook the chicken breast meat in a little oil until fully cooked.
Combine the cooked rice, chicken, and remaining ingredients in a large bowl.
Chill until served. Optional: add other fruits like grapes, mandarins, or plums for variation.

_similar.keywords: Caribbean chicken salad, fruit and rice salad, Italian dressing

_similar.name: Coleslaw Chalet Dressing
_similar.description: A classic coleslaw recipe with a tangy dressing made with white vinegar, sugar, and spices.

recipeInstructions.text: Bring all dressing ingredients to a boil and let cool.
Keep shredded cabbage and other ingredients in a glass or enamel container.
Pour dressing over the cabbage mixture and refrigerate tightly covered for several hours before using.

_similar.name: Cornbread Salad
_similar.description: A layered salad with crumbled cornbread, black beans, corn, cheese, and a creamy dressing, perfect for chilling before serving.
recipeIngredient: 1 (11 oz) can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (15 oz) can black beans, rinsed and drained
½ cup salad dressing or mayonnaise
½ cup chopped fresh cilantro or parsley
6 plum or tiny tim tomatoes, shredded

recipeInstructions.text: Prepare cornbread mix according to package directions and let cool. Crumble into pieces.
In a food processor or blender, combine salad dressing (or mayonnaise), lime juice, cumin, and salt. Process until smooth.
Layer half of the lettuce, cornbread, dressing mixture, beans, corn, cheese, red bell pepper, green onions, and tomatoes in a 4-quart bowl.
Repeat the layers, finishing with the remaining dressing on top. Garnish as desired with cilantro or onion curls.
Cover and chill for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

_similar.keywords: Cornbread salad, layered salad, Southwestern salad
